notes: This is an offline game word list, not a complete or authoritative English dictionary.
A word missing here is not necessarily invalid English; the game only reports that it is not in the built-in list.
The word list is shared across all player levels. CEFR level never restricts which accepted words a player may enter.
The list was filtered to alphabetic entries and common name/place exclusions, but some edge cases may remain.
